name: What if the owner wants a luxury detached ADU finish package?

mainEntity.name: How much does a luxury finish package change the cost and timeline of a detached ADU?
mainEntity.text: How much does a luxury finish package change the cost and timeline of a detached ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury finishes can transform a detached ADU, but they also change the project economics. Higher-end cabinetry, stone surfaces, custom tile, designer fixtures, upgraded windows, and specialty lighting all add cost, and many of those items take longer to order and install than standard selections. Premium finishes can also require more coordination between trades, especially if the design includes custom millwork or built-in features. Homeowners should decide early whether the goal is a value-driven rental unit or a showcase-level guest house. That decision affects not only the budget, but also the schedule and procurement strategy. The smartest luxury projects start with a realistic base build and then layer upgrades selectively where they create the most visual and functional value. That keeps the budget from ballooning on items that do not meaningfully improve the space.
acceptedAnswer.description: A luxury finish package can significantly increase both cost and build time because it often adds custom cabinetry, upgraded fixtures, premium flooring, specialty lighting, and longer lead times for materials.
